# Aim

> Aim is building a personal finance app with an AI assistant for spending, cash flow, and savings goals. Kazakhstan is the intended first market.

The site offers a product preview, a market overview, an early-access waitlist, and an investor contact form. The site labels its subscription scenarios as illustrative.

- [English](https://theaim.app/en/)
- [Kazakh](https://theaim.app/kz/)
- [Russian](https://theaim.app/ru/)
